name: Jewish cemetery Heiliger Sand: public tour
note: UNESCO SchUM, max 6 people, tickets via ticket-regional.de
description: guided walk through Europe's oldest Jewish cemetery
details:
Heiliger Sand in Worms is the oldest preserved Jewish cemetery in Europe, with gravestones from the 11th century on. Together with Speyer and Mainz it forms the UNESCO World Heritage site "ShUM sites", the medieval centres of Jewish learning on the Rhine.

The Worms tourist information runs public guided walks through the cemetery once a week; in November they start at 14:00, the last one of the season is on 27 November. Groups are small (up to six people), so book ahead via ticket-regional.de or the tourist information. Men are asked to cover their head on Jewish cemeteries.
